verdict_reason: The four endpoint lookups changed by 1f523d5e correctly preserve ordinary left/up named-note edges for the supported grammar, but the corrected account's broader lifecycle invariant is still false. Fresh valid Component inputs preserve additional Java Link objects that Rust drops before logical endpoint normalization. This causes missing ordinary note edges and shifted/reused link UIDs for bold bodies, dot-bodied directions, direction abbreviations, bracket line styles, hidden-link lifecycle, and valid endpoint decorations. Under the requested gate, any one of these missing-edge or UID counterexamples rejects the mechanism.
commands: for f in test-diagrams/perturbations/component-named-note-ordinary-edge-lifecycle/followup/*.puml; do /private/tmp/rustuml-component-note-edges-followup/target/release/rustuml --no-oracle -tsvg "$f" > "${f%.puml}.rust.svg" || exit $?; done

java_evidence: CommandLinkElement.executeArg at lines 201-241 parses the complete endpoint decoration and direction grammar, constructs a source-order Link, and replaces it with Link.getInv() for LEFT or UP before diagram.addLink.

Link's constructor at lines 123-137 allocates the link UID, while Link.getInv at lines 145-155 allocates a second UID and swaps entities, decorations, endpoint labels, ports, and LinkArg identity as one object.

GraphvizImageBuilder.buildImage at lines 226-259 constructs and registers every surviving SvekEdge before Opale marking; onlyOneLink at lines 313-326 decides note cardinality from the retained Link objects.

SvekEdge's constructor at lines 226-257 derives ports and endpoint clusters from link.getEntity1/getEntity2; solveLine at lines 611-648 orients Graphviz's path against those same nodes; drawU at lines 824-849 emits the same Link UID and endpoint entity UIDs.
The Java JAR accepted all 22 fresh inputs with -checkonly and emitted no syntax-error or exception marker in any SVG.
rust_evidence: The parser keeps source-order Connection.from/to and a direction enum. no_oracle_layout_edge_ends at component.rs:6857-6866 is the single left/up inversion point used by layout and paint.

Commit 1f523d5e changes component/interface paint lookups at component.rs:3577-3596 from conn.from/conn.to to logical_from/logical_to. The standard reversed matrices now match Java link IDs, endpoint UIDs, path IDs, labels, link types, and polygon endpoint side.

RE_DESCRIPTION_CONN at component parser lines 46-50 admits only a subset of Java's valid body and endpoint decoration characters; RE_DESCRIPTION_LINK_DIRECTION at lines 54-55 admits only hyphen-prefixed full direction names and is applied to the whole source line.
A valid relation that those regexes reject never reaches connections.push at lines 1123-1140, so layout, UID simulation, Opale cardinality, and the corrected paint normalizer cannot preserve it.

component_opalized_floating_note at component.rs:1000-1022 counts only retained Rust Connection values. Dropping a hidden or otherwise styled relation can therefore turn Java's multiply linked note into a Rust single-link note and suppress its visible ordinary edge.
source_review.fixture_shape_search: No shipping branch or lookup is keyed to any Follow* held-out label. Ledger/Memo strings occur only in tests below cfg(test), not in production endpoint resolution. The 1f523d5e shipping hunk consists solely of four identity substitutions from conn.from/conn.to to logical_from/logical_to.
source_review.constant_audit: The 1f523d5e production change adds or changes no numeric constant, threshold, metrics table, or branch condition. No unexplained parity-affecting constant was introduced by the logical endpoint normalization fix.

comparison_method.validity: The pinned Java JAR returned exit 0 for -checkonly over all 22 fresh inputs. Generated Java and Rust SVGs were scanned for syntax errors, diagram-description errors, exceptions, and parse-error markers; none were present.
comparison_method.inventory: For each same-stem pair, the checker extracted entity qualified-name to UID mappings and every link group's ID, endpoint entity UIDs, source line, link type, path ID, labels, and decoration element inventory. Polygon centroids were classified against the first path's start/end coordinates to detect arrowhead-side reversal without requiring pixel-identical geometry.

findings.title: Dropped styled links corrupt note cardinality and global link UID lifecycle
evidence: followup_18_hidden_link_uid_lifecycle: Java emits note edge lnk8 and control lnk9; Rust emits only the unrelated control as lnk8.
followup_21_bracket_line_styles: Java emits six visible note edges; Rust emits none after dropping six styled relations and Opale-suppressing the sole parsed control.
findings.mechanism: Rust computes Opale eligibility and UID simulation from its incomplete parsed Connection list. Java computes both from retained Link objects before SvekEdge paint. Logical endpoint normalization cannot repair relations that disappeared before that boundary.

findings.title: Valid direction grammar still loses edges and shifts inverted-link UIDs
evidence: followup_15_parallel_endpoint_routes: Java emits four links including dot-bodied .right.> and .left.>; Rust emits two and shifts reverse-solid from Java lnk7 to Rust lnk6.
followup_22_direction_abbreviations: Java emits eight links for l/le/r/ri/u/d/do plus full right; Rust emits zero visible links.
findings.mechanism: Java CommandLinkElement accepts direction aliases and direction text between any valid body segments. Rust's direction regex accepts only -(down|up|left|right) followed by [-.>], so valid Link identities never reach no_oracle_layout_edge_ends.

findings.title: Valid link body and endpoint decoration grammar drops ordinary named-note edges
evidence: followup_08_line_style_bodies: the bold ==> link is missing in Rust (Java 4, Rust 3).
followup_19_extended_endpoint_decors: six of eight valid links are missing in Rust.
followup_20_remaining_endpoint_decors: ten of twenty valid links are missing in Rust.
findings.mechanism: RE_DESCRIPTION_CONN's arrow character class is narrower than CommandLinkElement HEAD/BODY/STYLE grammar. Missing parser objects entail missing layout edges, paint groups, and UID consumption.

findings.title: Parsed endpoint decorations do not survive generic ordinary-edge paint
evidence: followup_07_supported_endpoint_decors: Java emits aggregation, composition, square, and circle endpoint shapes on all eight links; Rust emits the same edge groups as undecorated associations.
findings.mechanism: The current Connection model records only arrows, extension triangles, and a few socket shapes, so other Java LinkDecor identities collapse before paint.

findings.title: Direction stripping mutates valid center labels
findings.mechanism: RE_DESCRIPTION_LINK_DIRECTION.replace_all runs over the entire trimmed relation line rather than only the arrow token.

findings.title: The four logical endpoint lookup substitutions repair the originally reported left/up omission
evidence: followup_03_left_up_reversed_matrix, followup_09_interfaces_components_brackets, followup_10_package_endpoints, followup_11_nested_alias_ownership, followup_12_order_count_variant_a, followup_13_order_count_variant_b, and followup_14_cardinality_direction_matrix retain every expected link and match Java metadata/orientation.
findings.mechanism: For parsed supported relations, component, interface, package, and named-note paint lookup now consistently consumes logical_from/logical_to.

verdict_gate: REJECT. Seven fresh Java-valid cases contain missing ordinary edges or link UID lifecycle divergence. The corrected left/up endpoint fix works within its narrow parsed grammar, but the account's complete ordinary-edge lifecycle invariant is not satisfied.
